title: Slotted PVC wiring duct with cover, 60 × 80 mm, 2 m

sources.citation: game-design: unverified product class. Slotted rigid-PVC wiring duct for control panels is catalogued in metric width × height sections (25 × 40, 40 × 60 and 60 × 80 mm among them) and sold in 2 m lengths with a clip-on cover; the class was recalled, not read from a dimension sheet in this PR, so the 60 × 80 mm section and 2000 mm stock length stay game-design until electrical-realism-reviewer checks them against public manufacturer dimension data. sizeMm: the stock length along +x, the width on the plate (+y), the height off it (+z).

game-design: unverified. A 2.2 mm wall and base, 6 mm slots between 8 mm fingers (the class has walls of roughly 1.5 to 2.5 mm and slots of 4 to 8 mm; not read from one sheet). Drawn, and read by F3.2 for the inside.
game-design: a new piece is cut to 300 mm (it fits the Pellmoor panel’s 350 mm backplate); raceway.cut makes pieces from 20 mm up to the 2 m stock length.

game-design: duct is screwed or riveted to a panel backplate (common practice), lying along the plate’s +x; its width along the mount is its cut length (the 2000 mm here is the stock, replaced by the cut).
